intro: In Stormwind Keep, Donyal Tovald copies the kingdom’s histories for those with library scrips. Young King Anduin Wrynn has set aside royal funds for the work, opening these accounts of Azeroth to citizens and scholars.

clips.title: Progress
paras: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do any of these titles interest you, friend?
